name: valyria-chrome
description: Valyria's workbench identity — the product icon theme, a file icon theme (stock Seti file icons + Valyria folder icons), and the chrome defaults that keep it from feeling like a VS Code fork.
//: Code-free by design (no `main`), like theme/: an extension with no main is never disabled by workspace trust (extensionManifestPropertiesService: !manifest.main => untrusted-supported), so the Valyria icon themes and the chrome `configurationDefaults` hold even after opening an untrusted repo. The file icon theme is stock Seti (vendored MIT copy in vendor/seti) with only the folder icons swapped for Valyria's — file-type icons are untouched. Bundled built-in: scripts/bootstrap.sh symlinks this dir to vscode/extensions/valyria-chrome. dist/ is generated by tools/build_icons.py and committed (CI never needs fontTools).
